graph.name: LeasePlan OneConnect Telematics Platform
graph.notes: LeasePlan's OneConnect telematics platform ingests vehicle sensor data, enriches it with OpenStreetMap data, detects safety events using Kinesis sliding windows, and exports enriched data via Glue to on-premises data centers.

nodes.name: IOT
nodes.notes: Vehicle sensors capturing speed, g-force, GPS, and vehicle computer telematics data.

nodes.name: LAMBDA (Ingestion)
nodes.notes: Ingests raw vehicle sensor telematics data.

nodes.name: S3 (Raw Data Lake)
nodes.notes: Stores raw telematics data forming the initial data lake.

nodes.name: SQS
nodes.notes: Buffers and batches telematics data for scalable processing and durability.

nodes.name: S3 (OpenStreetMaps)
nodes.notes: Stores pre-chunked OpenStreetMap map data provided via AWS Open Data Initiative.

nodes.name: LAMBDA (Enrichment)
nodes.notes: Enriches telematics batches with pre-chunked map data chunks.

nodes.name: KINESIS
nodes.notes: Runs sliding window queries to detect events like speeding.

nodes.name: ATHENA
nodes.notes: Runs background queries to pre-chunk map data and query raw telematics data.

nodes.name: S3 (Enriched Data)
nodes.notes: Stores enriched event data and telemetry results.

nodes.name: GLUE
nodes.notes: ETL job that transfers enriched and summary data to destination systems.

nodes.name: On-Prem Data Center
nodes.notes: On-premises destination powering reports, dashboards, and customer applications.

edges.notes: Vehicle IoT sensors send raw telematics data to Ingestion Lambda.
Ingestion Lambda stores raw telemetry into S3 data lake.
Raw telemetry is batched and loaded into SQS.
SQS sends batched messages to Enrichment Lambda.
Enrichment Lambda pulls map chunks from OpenStreetMap S3 bucket.
Enrichment Lambda feeds data into Kinesis for real-time event detection.
Enrichment Lambda writes enriched telematics to enriched S3 bucket.
Kinesis outputs detected safety events into enriched S3 bucket.
Athena queries raw telematics data in S3.
Athena query results are passed to Glue.
Glue reads enriched event data from S3.
Glue pushes data to the on-premises data center.
